name: kaufland_marketplace-mcp
display_name: Kaufland Global Marketplace (sales channel) + Marketplace Seller API MCP
description: Kaufland Global Marketplace (sales channel) + Marketplace Seller API (ecommerce suppliers): me, list

platform_mcp_kaufland_marketplace_client.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KAUFLAND_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_KEY
platform_mcp_kaufland_marketplace_client.description: Kaufland Marketplace Client Key (32 characters, seller portal API settings), sent as the Shop-Client-Key header.

platform_mcp_kaufland_marketplace_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KAUFLAND_MARKETPLACE_SECRET_KEY
platform_mcp_kaufland_marketplace_secret.description: The Secret Key (64 characters): signs every request (hex HMAC-SHA256 over METHOD, full URI, body and Unix timestamp joined by newlines, sent as Shop-Signature with Shop-Timestamp). Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_kaufland_marketplace_storef.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KAUFLAND_MARKETPLACE_STOREFRONT
platform_mcp_kaufland_marketplace_storef.description: Kaufland storefront for product calls: de, cz, sk, pl, at, fr, it, es or nl (GET /v2/info/storefront lists yours).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v2/info/storefront: the storefronts created for the signed-in seller ({data: ["de", ...]}).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Searches the Kaufland MARKETPLACE catalogue of the configured storefront; `query` (q) is required by the endpoint and `category` is not a filter here. Offers and prices are not embedded in search results.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /v2/products/{id_product}?embedded=units: the product with its offers units[{id_unit, condition, amount, price, delivery_time_min/max, seller}]. Unit prices are the API's integer price values, returned as first_offer_price rather than the decimal `price`.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: A customer order placed with you: {id_order, ts_created_iso, storefront, order_units[{id_order_unit, status (need_to_be_sent, sent, received, cancelled, returned, ...), price, currency, product}], shipping_address, billing_address, buyer}. Status is tracked per order unit; `status` is the first unit's.
